server.note: Kept in English; masculine, invariable. Existing: 'Aggiungi server' (Add Server), 'Rimuovi server' (Remove Server). Avoid legacy plural 'Servers' in Italian text.

tab.note: Existing usage is split between 'scheda' ('Apri in una nuova scheda') and kept 'Tab' ('Seleziona Prossimo Tab'); prefer 'scheda', the standard Italian browser term. Feminine; plural 'schede'.

view.note: Existing renders 'View limit reached' as 'Limite di visualizzazione raggiunto'; the &View menu is '&Vista'. Use 'vista' for the countable server view.

popout window.note: Verb 'pop out' = 'aprire in una finestra separata'. No established existing rendering.

system tray.note: Official Windows Italian term; existing string uses the variant 'area notifiche' — prefer 'area di notifica'.

notification area.note: Same term as system tray, matching Windows Italian; existing: 'Mostra l'icona nell'area notifiche'.

minimize to tray.target: ridurre a icona nell'area di notifica
minimize to tray.note: Existing menu item is just 'Riduci ad Icona'; add 'nell'area di notifica' when the distinction from normal minimize matters.

taskbar.note: Official Windows Italian term; existing usage matches.

badge.note: Kept in English, as in Apple/Microsoft Italian UI; masculine, invariable. Unread badge = 'badge dei non letti'.

bounce.note: macOS Dock icon animation; Apple Italian uses 'rimbalzare' ('l'icona rimbalza nel Dock').

flash.note: Existing string uses 'Evidenzia l'icona' — 'lampeggiare' is the accurate Windows term for taskbar flashing; noted as an intentional improvement.

start app on login.note: Existing: 'Avvia l'app al login', 'Avvia l'app minimizzata' (Launch app minimized).

check for updates.note: Existing menu item: 'Controlla Aggiornamenti'; settings: 'Controlla automaticamente gli aggiornamenti'.

downloads.note: Kept in English, masculine invariable, as in Chrome/Firefox Italian; existing usage is split ('Scaricamenti', 'Posizione di Download', 'Annulla Scaricamento') — prefer 'download'.

developer tools.note: Existing: 'Strumenti di Sviluppo'. Chrome Italian uses 'Strumenti per sviluppatori', but keep the established in-app form.

certificate.note: Existing consistent: 'Errore di Certificato', 'Seleziona un certificato'.

authentication secret.note: No existing rendering; 'segreto' is the standard Italian term for shared secrets.

dark mode.note: Existing: 'Passa alla Modalità Scura' (Toggle Dark Mode).

zoom.note: Kept in English (masculine). Existing: 'Aumenta lo zoom' (Zoom In), 'Diminuisci lo zoom' (Zoom Out).

full screen.note: Existing: 'Passa a Schermo Intero' (Toggle Full Screen), 'a pieno schermo' also appears — prefer 'schermo intero'.

clear data.note: Existing related items: 'Svuota Cache e Ricarica' (Clear Cache and Reload). Clear All Data = 'Cancella tutti i dati'.

logging level.note: 'log' kept in English, masculine invariable; Show logs = 'Mostra i log'.
